The barrel is light beige/tan with significant brown staining or weathering patterns on its surface. A green downspout feeds into the top/side of the barrel. Near the base, there is a white spigot with a hose attached. In the foreground, there are small potted plants and mulch. To the left, a green wooden structure (possibly a shed or fence) is visible.
